prompt: Trong mặt phẳng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, cho tam giác <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math> có <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>. Phương trình đường cao <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>H</mi></mrow></semantics></math> của tam giác <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math> có dạng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>, tính <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow></semantics></math>.
solution:
Đường cao AH của tam giác ABC nhận véc-tơ BC→=(5;3) là véc-tơ pháp tuyến.
Phương trình đường cao AH là 5(x−1)+3(y+2)=0⇔5x+3y+1=0.
Do đó a=5, b=1. Vậy a−b=5−1=4.
